title: The Dyed Ribbon on the Line
youtube_title: The Dyed Ribbon on the Line | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Opal wants to check on a dyed ribbon dripping on the indoor line before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Opal leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
